others: Security updates are listed below according to the software release in which they first appeared. Where possible, CVE IDs (http://cve.mitre.org/cve/) are used to reference the vulnerabilities for further information.
For information about newer security updates, see technical document 61798, "Apple security updates".
fb_realpath(): Addresses CAN-2003-0466, a potential vulnerability in the fb_realpath() function, which could allow a local or remote user to gain unauthorized root privileges to a system.
Workgroup Manager: Fixes CAN-2003-0601 to improve the security of your system by assigning a "disabled" password to a new account.
